title: The write step writes a WordPress site's logo, dark logo and tab icon as options, keeps highlighted words' accent, and the site check reads a Cloudflare-hidden address as mail
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: On the JA Diner WordPress 1.0.4 kit, whose header prints a Site Logo block, the logo, the dark logo and the tab icon are ordered as the options site_logo, tracy_logo_dark and site_icon; each picture is uploaded to wp-content/uploads/tracy-brand/ and its option names the attachment, read back through content.get; a dark spot with no picture is set to 0; the look guard and the WordPress door open no other option.
A WordPress inline-markup slot takes the writer's emphasis inside the demo's accent span; a link to /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection is never walked as a page.

tests: the theme header prints a Site Logo block, so the logo, the dark logo and the tab icon are options
each picture is uploaded to the brand folder and its option names the attachment; each reads back
a picture the site holds already goes once more under its own name, so its option names a real attachment
🔒 the look guard opens only the options the kit names, as the id of a picture
the writer's emphasis is wrapped in the demo's accent span where the plugin keeps the slot's markup
an address Cloudflare hides is a mail link in disguise, never a page that does not answer
